selection: All seven existing panel channels and recorded doses; no outcome-driven ranking or new interventions.
method: Four independent L27 claim-clarification branches with identical saved history in on/off arms (8 replies), followed by 10 fresh safety questions across all seven channels plus one undosed control each (80 replies). Greedy max500 throughout. Channel order rotates per fresh question. No generated reply is fed into another.
stop_rule: Wait for the original L27 follow-up queue to complete and release the lock. Run at most 88 replies or five hours. No retry after resource guard stops, no automatic new questions or changed doses.
interpretation: Generated references to real people are unverified model text. Retain all answers and matched controls. No proof of intent, actual affiliation, capabilities, or novelty is inferred.
